issue:
MySQL XOR is parsed at AND precedence and optimizer folds a true expression to false

## Summary and reproduction

With `sqlglot==30.23.0`:

```python
import sqlglot
from sqlglot.optimizer import optimize
query = "SELECT TRUE XOR FALSE AND FALSE"
print(optimize(sqlglot.parse_one(query, read="mysql"), dialect="mysql"))
```

Observed on 2026-10-19: `SELECT FALSE AS "_col_0"`. [MySQL binds `AND` above logical `XOR`](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/operator-precedence.html), so the source means `TRUE XOR (FALSE AND FALSE)` and is true. The observed fold corresponds to `(TRUE XOR FALSE) AND FALSE`, which is false.

The [MySQL parser configuration](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/blob/ad8764a0436a7b5c500b783ebe50dbf20c1e477c/sqlglot/parsers/mysql.py#L72-L80) puts `XOR` in the `CONJUNCTION` tier alongside `AND`, so the parser builds the grouping that the optimizer folds to false.
